categories.title: Pokécenter
categories.info: Poké Centers allow trainers to heal their Pokémon and change their team. They also contain basic shops and TM Machines.

categories.title: TM
categories.info: Use TMs to teach Pokémon new compatible moves. Craft them at Poké Centers using the indicated materials, which you can get by defeating their corresponding Wild Pokémon.

categories.title: Battle Item
categories.info: Battle items are useful items that can be used during a battle to increase your Pokémon's stats. Use them when you need an extra boost!

categories.title: Key Item
categories.info: Key items are items that are notable to the story or your character.

categories.title: Medicine
categories.info: Medicines are items that can be used to heal your Pokémon inside and outside of battle, or to cure status effects.

categories.title: Poké Ball
categories.info: Pokéballs are used to capture wild Pokémon. Different Pokéball types can increase your catch chance!

categories.title: Treasure
categories.info: Treasures are items with no actual use, but they can be sold at shops for a high price.

categories.title: Trainer
categories.info: Defeat other Trainers for prize money. Their pokemon's levels, and reward you get for defeating them, may change based on your level.

categories.title: Legendary Pokémon
categories.info: Legendary Pokémon can only be fought once, so make sure to capture them!

categories.title: Tera Pokémon
categories.info:
Tera Pokémon are like typical Wild Pokémon, who start the battle Terastallized. Lower their HP to break the Tera state and catch them! 

Tera Pokémon have a chance to respawn every day at midnight.

locations.title: Perrin
locations.description:
Return to Perrin after registering 150 Pokémon in the Kitakami Pokédex for a [trainer battle](#loc=303600).

After completing the battle you will unlock the side quest for the [Bloodmoon Form Ursaluna](#loc=305213)

locations.title: Software Developer
locations.description:
Speak to the Software Developer to turn on/off Rotom Phone matching app design. 

When turned on, apps on the Rotom Phone will match your case.

locations.title: Professor Jacq
locations.description: Jacq will hand you an Egg during this interaction. Once hatched, you'll receive a Piplup, Turtwig, or Chimchar, depending on which one has the type advantage against the starter you chose.

locations.title: Picnicker
locations.description: Speak to NPC to receive a variety of ingredients or rest.

locations.title: Chair Designer
locations.description:
The NPC requests to see your picnic tablecloth for design inspiration. You will receive a set of handmade chairs!

You can return with new tablecloths to receive different chairs.

locations.title: Lovey-Dovey Couple
locations.description: Show one of these two NPCs a Tandemaus or a Moushold and they'll reward you with the Heart (Right) emote and Heart (Left) emote.

locations.title: Muramasa of the Kitakami Ogre Clan
locations.description:
Provides rewards for each member of the Ogre Clan Defeated:

1. Focus Sash  
2. Exp. Candy XL x5  
3. Assault Vest  
4. Rare Candy x10  
5. Choice Specs  
6. Ability Capsule x3  
7. Choice Band
